title: GTA 6 Leaks Confirm Iconic 6-Star Wanted Level System Returns
description: Recent gameplay leaks covered by Polygon indicate that GTA 6 will feature a six-star wanted system, potentially bringing back tank cop chases.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Leaks Point to the Return of the Iconic 6-Star Wanted System

According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Polygon, new gameplay leaks suggest that Grand Theft Auto 6 will feature a six-star wanted system. This potential inclusion could signal the triumphant return of the classic high-level police response, including the much-loved tank cop chases that fans have missed for over a decade.

The wanted level system has always been a cornerstone of the GTA franchise's chaotic open-world sandbox design. While Grand Theft Auto V streamlined the maximum threat level to five stars back in 2013, veteran players have frequently reminisced about the absolute chaos and overwhelming military response associated with the classic six-star status.

## Escalated Law Enforcement and Potential Tank Chases

With Polygon highlighting the six-star system found in the leaked gameplay, speculation naturally turns to how modern hardware and Rockstar Games' advanced AI will handle a maximum-threat scenario. In past iterations of the series, reaching the absolute peak of the wanted meter meant facing off against the full might of the military, resulting in intense tank chases and total lockdown conditions.

If these leaked mechanics translate to the final release of GTA 6, players can anticipate a significantly heightened level of challenge when clashing with law enforcement in the fictional state of Leonida. The combination of smarter police AI and heavier military-grade opposition would elevate the sandbox escape gameplay to entirely new heights.

As always with leaked development material, players should keep in mind that features are subject to change until officially detailed by Rockstar Games.

## Editor's Take

The potential return of the six-star wanted system after 13 years is an exciting prospect for longtime fans. The chaos of high-level police pursuits has always defined the quintessential GTA experience. If Rockstar manages to integrate this ultimate threat tier with next-gen technology and aggressive tactical AI, the resulting mayhem during a max-star escape will undoubtedly be worth the long wait.
